activity.notes: The 7 April 1963 constitution renamed the state the Socialist Federal Republic of Yugoslavia. Tito remained President through this constitutional phase until his death on 4 May 1980; he was made president without a term limit in the 1974 constitutional framework.

sources.title: Constituent Acts of Yugoslavia — Archives of Yugoslavia
sources.citation_text: The Archives records the Constitution of 7 April 1963, the state's renaming to the SFRY, and Tito's presidential status.

sources.title: Broz, Josip - Tito — Hrvatska enciklopedija
sources.citation_text: The Croatian Encyclopedia states that Tito was President of Yugoslavia from 1953 and remained the country's ruler until his death in 1980.
